cases.research_question: Does removing the reset-time DOWNRUPT alter later V37/P63 acceptance at the common horizon?
cases.limitation: This deliberately removes a pending simulator reset interrupt; it is not a measured Apollo hardware failure rate.

cases.research_question: Does forcing channel 015 low while Pinball consumes the first key prevent the full V37E63E sequence from being verified?
cases.limitation: The duration is an adversarial instruction-window stimulus, not an electrical switch model.

cases.research_question: Is a one-bit MODREG corruption immediately before the rope stores major mode 63 masked by that store?
cases.limitation: This is a positive-control masking case tied to the observed baseline write order.

cases.research_question: Does suppressing the channel-7 superbank selector around the P63 transfer prevent the physical F32 entry path?
cases.limitation: The forced window approximates a control-interface fault and does not model relay timing.

cases.research_question: How quickly does a one-bit mutation of the first P63LM word become architecturally visible, and does mission evidence recover?
cases.limitation: Core rope was read-only in flight; this adversarial mutation measures software sensitivity, not a realistic in-flight write mechanism.

cases.research_question: Is a one-bit accumulator upset at P63LM entry overwritten, propagated, or reflected in acceptance evidence?
cases.limitation: The fault is instantaneous at an instruction boundary and omits analog upset duration.

cases.research_question: Does a post-write bit flip in the P63 descent-velocity counter persist or get repaired by subsequent rope logic?
cases.limitation: The selected bit and boundary are deterministic sensitivity probes, not a radiation cross-section model.

cases.research_question: Does a low-bit perturbation of the freshly written landing target X component alter later guidance state by the horizon?
cases.limitation: No vehicle dynamics are coupled, so the outcome concerns software state propagation only.

cases.research_question: Does a +100 one’s-complement TIME1 jump after P63 entry change scheduling or mission evidence at the shared horizon?
cases.limitation: The instantaneous timer discontinuity is a software robustness stimulus, not an oscillator model.

cases.research_question: Are single opposing IMU pulses after P63 entry visible in the software trace and retained guidance state?
cases.limitation: This injects discrete counter pulses and does not simulate platform mechanics or sensor noise spectra.

cases.research_question: Does an explicit radar sample and RADAR interrupt after range-display computation alter subsequent software state before the horizon?
cases.limitation: The sample is synthetic and uncoupled from a lunar trajectory or radar measurement model.
